# The Scientific World

> A comprehensive science and technology portal delivering breaking research discoveries, health insights, and real-world applications of emerging technologies.

The Scientific World is an editorial platform founded by Mahtab Alam Quddusi that covers cutting-edge scientific research, medical breakthroughs, technology trends, and their practical implications for daily life. The site emphasizes evidence-based content spanning biomedical research, artificial intelligence, consumer technology, and digital transformation.

## Key Topics

- Artificial Intelligence
- Medical Research
- Technology Products
- Health & Wellness
- Food Science
- Digital Transformation
- Cloud Computing
- Data Science
- Skincare & Cosmetics
- Science News
- Daily Life Applications
- India Tech Ecosystem
- Malaria Research
- PDRN Technology
- Blockchain

## Core Portal

- [The Scientific World - Let's have a moment of science](https://www.scientificworldinfo.com): Homepage featuring science news, tech trends, health tips, and lifestyle articles
- [About Us](https://www.scientificworldinfo.com/p/about-us.html): Portal overview by Mahtab Alam Quddusi covering mission, trust, and editorial policy

- [Scientists Create the Hardest AI Test Yet—Results Will Shock You](https://www.scientificworldinfo.com/2026/03/scientists-create-hardest-ai-test-yet.html): Humanity's Last Exam: AI benchmarking reveals limits of language models
- [Does Childhood Stress Really Affect Digestive Health Later in Life?](https://www.scientificworldinfo.com/2026/03/does-childhood-stress-affect-lifelong-digestive-health.html): Childhood stress impact on gut-brain axis and IBS development later in life
- [How Does PDRN Toner Reverse Aging Signs and Improve Skin?](https://www.scientificworldinfo.com/2026/03/how-does-pdrn-toner-reverse-aging-signs-improve-skin.html): PDRN toner analysis: collagen boost, skin cell repair, anti-aging benefits
